## Historical Task Snapshot
User requested a comprehensive configuration checkpoint summarizing project settings, host parameters, and team constraints across multiple services (Aurora, Umbra, Lyra, Nimbus, Ember, Flint, Yukon, Velvet, Fjord, Onyx, Yarrow, Rune, Zenith, Alder, Quill, Iris, Jasper, Opal, Nova, Lumen, Thistle) from January 2026 through April 2026. The user specifically emphasized preserving exact configuration values, including current defaults, scope-specific exceptions (e.g., weekends, staging, canary clusters), rejected proposals with reasons, and lessons learned regarding network constraints (MTU) and credential handling. No outstanding tasks remain; the request was for a retrospective summary of prior work.

## Goal
